validation.existing_unittest_suite: NOT RUN IN ARTIFACT ENVIRONMENT - Flask package unavailable; run in project venv

safety_notes: Portable backup uses SQLite online backup API for results.db consistency.
Temporary uploads, restore/backups, staging data, temporary logos, and SQLite WAL/SHM/journal sidecars are excluded.
Restore validates ZIP CRC, schema, traversal, symlinks, duplicate paths, file counts, single-file size, and total expansion before confirmation.
Restore creates a pre-restore safety backup and attempts automatic rollback if applying the selected snapshot fails.
Narrow source-content reset uses existing Content Pack dependency snapshotting and preserves protected packs.
Full data reset preserves backup ZIPs and does not remove the application executable/source installation.
